spans.s: धर (I) a. (f. रा or री) Holding, carrying, wearing, containing, possessed of &c., e.g. गदाधर, अंशुधर, अक्षधर, असृग्धर.

धर (II) m. 1. A mountain, उत्कं धरं द्रष्टुमवेक्ष्य शौरिम् Sis.iv.18; 2. a flock of cotton; 3. a frivolous or dissolute man; 4. the king of the tortoises, i.e. Viṣṇu in his second or Kūrma incarnation.
धर (I) a. (f. रा or री) Holding, carrying, wearing, containing, possessed of &c., e.g. गदाधर, अंशुधर, अक्षधर, असृग्धर.
धरा f. 1. The earth, R.xv.85; 2. a vein; 3. marrow; 4. the uterus.
धार (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Holding, supporting; 2. streaming down, flowing.
धार (II) m. 1. An epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. a sudden and violent shower of rain; 3. snow, hail; 4. a deep place; 5. debt; 6. a boundary, a limit.
धार (I) a. (f. रा) 1. Holding, supporting; 2. streaming down, flowing.

धारा f. 1. A stream or current of water, a line of descending fluid, R.xvi.66, Megh.i.55; 2. a shower, a hard shower; 3. the pace of a horse, धाराः प्रसाधयितुमव्यतिकीर्णरूपाः Sis.v.60; 4. the margin, edge or border of any thing, ध्रुवं स नीलोत्पलपत्रधारया शमीलतां छेत्तुमृषिर्व्यवस्यति Sak.i.; 5. the sharp edge of a cutting instrument, धारां शितां रामपरश्वधस्य R.vi.42, xi.78; 6. the edge of a mountain or precipice; 7. a wheel or the periphery of a wheel, R.xiii.15; 8. a garden-wall, a fence; 9. a continuous line or series, Bh.V.ii.20; 10. the front line of an army; 11. the highest point, excellence; 12. a multitude; 13. fame; 14. night.
धर (I) a. (f. रा or री) Holding, carrying, wearing, containing, possessed of &c., e.g. गदाधर, अंशुधर, अक्षधर, असृग्धर.
धरण (I) a. (f. णी) Bearing, holding.
धरण (II) m. 1. A ridge of land answering the purpose of a bridge, the side of a mountain; 2. the world; 3. the sun; 4. the female breast; 5. rice, corn; 6. the Himālaya, king of mountains.
धरण (III) n. 1. Holding, upholding, supporting, धरणिधरणाकिणचक्रगरिष्ठे Git.G.i., K.S.i.17; 2. prop, support; 3. security; 4. a measure of weight equal to ten palas.
धारण (I) a. (f. णी) Holding, earning, preserving, assuming &c.
धारण (II) n. 1. The act of holding or supporting; 2. possessing, possession; 3. keeping in the memory, ग्रहणधारणपटुर्बालः Tarkadīpikā; 4. indebtedness.

धारणा f. 1. The act of holding, supporting, preserving; 2. the power of retaining in the mind, good memory; 3. keeping the mind collected, holding the breath suspended, steady abstraction of the mind, परिचेतुमुपांशु धारणाम् R.viii.18, M.vi.72; 4. fortitude, firmness; 5. a fixed precept or injunction, a settled rule, a conclusion,
इति धर्मस्य
धारणा M.viii.184; 6. understanding, intellect; 7. propriety.
धरण (I) a. (f. णी) Bearing, holding.
धरणि f. 1. The earth, धरणिधरणाकिणचक्रगरिष्ठे Git.G.i.; 2. a beam for a roof; 3. a vein.
धरणि f. 1. The earth, धरणिधरणाकिणचक्रगरिष्ठे Git.G.i.; 2. a beam for a roof; 3. a vein.
धारण (I) a. (f. णी) Holding, earning, preserving, assuming &c.
धारणी f. 1. A vein; 2. a row, a line.
धरणि-ईश्वर m. 1. a king; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 3. of Śiva.
धरणि-ईश्वर m. 1. a king; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 3. of Śiva.
धरणि-कीलक m. a mountain.

धरणि-धर m. 1. an epithet of Śeṣa; 2. of Viṣṇu; 3. a mountain; 4. a tortoise; 5. a king.
धरणि-धर m. 1. an epithet of Śeṣa; 2. of Viṣṇu; 3. a mountain; 4. a tortoise; 5. a king.
धरणि-धृत् m. 1. a mountain; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 3. of Śeṣa.
धरणि-धृत् m. 1. a mountain; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 3. of Śeṣa.
धरा-अधिप m. a king.
धरा-अमर, -देव, -सुर m. a Brāhmaṇa.
धरा-अमर, -देव, -सुर m. a Brāhmaṇa.
धरा-अमर, -देव, -सुर m. a Brāhmaṇa.
धरा-उद्धार m. deliverance of the earth.
धरा-आत्मज, -पुत्र, -सूनु m. 1. an epithet of the planet Mars; 2. of the demon Naraka.
धरा-आत्मजा f. an epithet of Sītā.
धरा-आत्मज, -पुत्र, -सूनु m. 1. an epithet of the planet Mars; 2. of the demon Naraka.
धरा-आत्मज, -पुत्र, -सूनु m. 1. an epithet of the planet Mars; 2. of the demon Naraka.
धरा-धर m. 1. a mountain; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa; 3. of Śeṣa.
धारा-धर m. 1. a cloud; 2. a sword.
धरा-पति m. 1. a king; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
धरा-भुज् n. a king.
धरा-भृत् m. a mountain.
धरित्री f. The earth, the soil, R.xiv.54, K.S.i.2, Am.
धरिमन् m. A balance, a pair of scales.
धर्त्तूर m. The dhattūra plant.
धर्त्र n. 1. A house; 2. a sacrifice; 3. virtue, moral merit.

धर्म m. 1. The prescribed course of conduct, the prescribed ceremonial, M.i.81; 3. ordinance, law, custom, practice, M.ii.12; 3. piety, propriety; 4. duty, एक एव सुहृद्धर्मो निधनेऽप्यनुयाति यः Hit.i.; 5. justice, equity; 6. moral merit; 7. nature, character; 8. an essential quality, a peculiarity; 9. resemblance, likeness; 10. a sacrifice; 11. good company; 12. an Upanishad q.v.; 13. the soul; 14. name of Yama, the god of death; 15. name of the eldest Pāṇḍava prince begotten on Kuntī by Yama, the god of death.
धर्म-अंग m. the Indian crane.
धर्म-अधर्म m. du. religion and irreligion.
धर्म-अधर्म˚विद् m. a Mīmānsāka who knows the right and wrong course of conduct.
धर्म-अधिकरण (I) n. 1. administration of the laws; 2. a court of justice.
धर्म-अधिकरण (II) m. a judge, a magistrate.
धर्म-अधिकरणिक, -अधिकरणिन् m. a judge, a magistrate.
धर्म-अधिकरणिक, -अधिकरणिन् m. a judge, a magistrate.
धर्म-अधिकार m. 1. administration of justice; 2. the office of a judge.
धर्म-अधिष्ठान n. a court of justice.
धर्म-अध्यक्ष m. 1. a judge; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
धर्म-अनुष्ठान n. virtuous conduct, moral conduct.
धर्म-अपेत (I) a. irreligious, immoral.
धर्म-अपेत (II) n. vice, injustice.
धर्म-अरण्य n. a sacred grove, a wood inhabited by ascetics, धर्मारण्यं प्रविशति गजः Sak.i.
धर्म-अलीक a. having a false character.
धर्म-आगम m. a law-book.
धर्म-आचार्य m. 1. a religious preceptor; 2. a teacher of law or of customs.
धर्म-चर्या f. observance of the law, performance of duty, K.S.vii.83.
धर्म-आत्मज m. an epithet of Yudhisthira, the eldest Pāṇḍava prince.
धर्म-आत्मन् a. pious, virtuous.
धर्म-आसन n. the throne of justice, the judgment seat, धर्मासनाद्विशति वासगृहं नरेंद्रः Ut.i.
धर्म-इंद्र m. an epithet of Yudhiṣṭhira, the first Pāṇḍava.
धर्म-ईश m. an epithet of Yama.
धर्म-उत्तर a. chiefly characterized by justice and impartiality, धर्मोत्तरं मध्यममाश्रयंते R.xiii.7.
धर्म-उपदेश m. 1. a discourse on law and religion; 2. the collective body of laws.
धर्म-कर्मन्, -कार्य न्।, -क्रिया ऋ। n. any act of duty or religion, virtuous conduct.
धर्म-कर्मन्, -कार्य न्।, -क्रिया ऋ। n. any act of duty or religion, virtuous conduct.
धर्म-क्रिया f. any act of duty or religion, virtuous conduct.
धर्म-कथादरिद्र m. the Kali age.
धर्म-काय m. an epithet of Buddha.
धर्म-कील m. a royal edict or decree.
धर्म-केतु m. an epithet of Buddha.
धर्म-कोश, -कोष m. the collective body of laws or duties, धर्मकोषस्य गुप्तये M.i.99.
धर्म-कोश, -कोष m. the collective body of laws or duties, धर्मकोषस्य गुप्तये M.i.99.
धर्म-क्षेत्र n. 1. Bhāratavarsha, the land of religion; 2. a plain near Delhi, the scene of the great battle between the Kauravas and Pāṇḍavas, धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः Bg.i.1.
धर्म-घट m. a jar of fragrant water offered daily to a Brāhmaṇa in the month of Vaiśākha.
धर्म-चक्रभृत् m. an epithet of Jina.
धर्म-चारिन् a. observing the law, virtuous, R.iii.45.
धर्म-चारिणी f. 1. a wife; 2. a virtuous wife.
धर्म-चिंतन n. study of virtue, moral reflection.
धर्म-चिंता f. study of virtue, moral reflection.
धर्म-ज m. 1. a legitimate son; See औरस and M.ix.107; 2. an epithet of Yudhiṣṭhira, the first Pāṇḍava.
धर्म-जन्मन् m. See धर्मज 2.
धर्म-जिज्ञासा f. inquiry into the right course of conduct, e.g. अथातो धर्मजिज्ञासा /Jaimini S./i.1.
धर्म-जीवन (I) a. living according to the rules of his class.
धर्म-जीवन (II) m. a Brāhmaṇa who lives by assisting others in the performance of religious duties.
धर्म-ज्ञ a. knowing the civil or religious law, M.vii.141.
धर्म-तस् ind. 1. rightly, justly; 2. virtuously, from a religious point of view.
धर्म-त्याग m. apostacy.
धर्म-दार m. pl. a lawful wife.
धर्म-द्रोहिन् m. a demon.
धर्म-धातु m. an epithet of Buddha.
धर्म-ध्वज, -ध्वजिन् a. a religious hypocrite, an impostor.
धर्म-ध्वज, -ध्वजिन् a. a religious hypocrite, an impostor.
धर्म-नंदन m. an epithet of Yudhiṣṭhira.
धर्म-नाथ m. a legal protector.
धर्म-नाभ m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
धर्म-निवेश m. religious devotion.
धर्म-निष्पत्ति f. 1. discharge of duty; 2. moral or religious observance.
धर्म-पत्नी f. a lawful wife, R.ii.2, 20, 72.
धर्म-पथ m. the way of virtue.
धर्म-पर a. pious, righteous.
धर्म-पाठक m. a teacher of civil or religious law.
धर्म-पाल m. chastisement, punishment.
धर्म-पीडा f. an offence against law.
धर्म-पुत्र m. 1. a lawful son, one begot from a sense of duty and not from pleasure; 2. an epithet of Yudhiṣṭhira.
धर्म-प्रवक्तृ m. an expounder of the law, a legal adviser.
धर्म-प्रवचन m. an epithet of Buddha.
धर्म-बाणिजिक, -वाणिजिक m. one who makes profit out of his virtue like a merchant.
धर्म-बाणिजिक, -वाणिजिक m. one who makes profit out of his virtue like a merchant.
धर्म-भगिनी f. 1. a lawful sister; 2. a daughter of the spiritual preceptor; 3. a woman of the same religious creed regarded as a sister.
धर्म-भागिनी f. a virtuous wife.
धर्म-भाणक m. a public reader of sacred books.
धर्म-भ्रातृ m. 1. a fellow religious student; 2. a son of the religious preceptor.
धर्म-महामात्र m. a minister in charge of religious affairs.
धर्म-मूल n. the foundation of civil or religious law.
धर्म-युग m. the Kṛta yuga.
धर्म-यूप m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
धर्म-रति a. delighting in justice, righteous, pious, just, R.i.23.
धर्म-राज् m. an epithet of Yama.
धर्म-राज m. 1. an epithet of Yama; 2. of Jina; 3. of Yudhiṣṭhira, the first Pāṇḍava prince; 4. a king.
धर्म-रोधिन् a. 1. opposed to law, illegal; 2. immoral.
धर्म-लक्षण n. the Mīmānsā philosophy.
धर्म-लोप m. irreligion.
धर्म-वासर m. the day of full moon.
धर्म-वाहन m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. a buffalo (as being the vehicle of Yama).
धर्म-विद् a. acquainted with the law (civil or religious).
धर्म-विप्लव m. violation of duty, immorality.
धर्म-विधि m. a legal precept or injunction.

धर्म-वीर m. the sentiment of heroism based on piety or righteousness, i.e. the sentiment of enthusiastic piety (in rhetoric); the following is an instance- सपदि विलयमेतु राज्यलक्ष्मीरुपरि पतंत्वथवा कृपाणधाराः । अपहरतुतरां शिरः कृतांतो मम तु मतिर्न मनागपैतु धर्मात् Bh.V.iv.26.
धर्म-वृद्ध a. advanced in virtue or piety.
धर्म-वैतंसिक m. one who gives away unlawfully acquired money in the hope of appearing generous.
धर्म-शाला f. 1. a court of justice, a tribunal; 2. a charitable institution.
धर्म-शासन, -शास्त्र n. a code of laws, Yaj.i.5.
धर्म-शासन, -शास्त्र n. a code of laws, Yaj.i.5.
धर्म-शील a. virtuous, pious.
धर्म-संहिता f. a code of laws (compiled by sages such as Manu, Yājnyavalkya &c.).
धर्म-संग m. 1. attachment to justice or virtue; 2. hypocrisy.
धर्म-सभा f. a court of justice.
धर्मयु a. Virtuous, pious, righteous.
धर्मिन् (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Virtuous, religious; 2. obeying the law, knowing one’s duties; 3. endowed with the properties of, having the qualifications of, कल्पवृक्षफलधर्मि कांक्षितम् R.xi.50.
धर्मिन् (II) m. An epithet of Viṣṇu.
धर्मिन् (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Virtuous, religious; 2. obeying the law, knowing one’s duties; 3. endowed with the properties of, having the qualifications of, कल्पवृक्षफलधर्मि कांक्षितम् R.xi.50.
धर्मीपुत्र m. An actor, a player.

धर्म्य a. (f. र्म्या) 1. Lawful, legal, consistent with duty, M.iii.22; 2. just, righteous, धर्म्याद्धि युद्धाच्छ्रेयोऽन्यत् क्षत्रियस्य न विद्यते Bg.ii.31; 3. legitimate; 4. endowed with any particular qualities; 5. religious, K.S.vi.13.

धर्म्य a. (f. र्म्या) 1. Lawful, legal, consistent with duty, M.iii.22; 2. just, righteous, धर्म्याद्धि युद्धाच्छ्रेयोऽन्यत् क्षत्रियस्य न विद्यते Bg.ii.31; 3. legitimate; 4. endowed with any particular qualities; 5. religious, K.S.vi.13.
धर्ष m. 1. Boldness, insolence, impudence; 2. impatience; 3. violation, seduction; 4. injury, wrong, insult; 5. a eunuch.
धर्ष-कारिणी f. a violated woman.
धर्षक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Assailing. assaulting; 2. violating; 3. impatient.
धर्षक (II) m. 1. A seducer, an adulterer; 2. an actor, a dancer.
धर्षक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Assailing. assaulting; 2. violating; 3. impatient.
धर्षण n. See the first four senses of धर्ष.
धर्षणा f. See the first four senses of धर्ष.
धर्षणि f. A wanton woman, a harlot.
धर्षणि f. A wanton woman, a harlot.
धर्षणि f. A wanton woman, a harlot.
धर्षणि f. A wanton woman, a harlot.
धर्षित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Violated; 2. defeated, overpowered, धर्षितपरास्तर्केषु यस्योक्तयः Na.xxii.155.
धर्षित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Violated; 2. defeated, overpowered, धर्षितपरास्तर्केषु यस्योक्तयः Na.xxii.155.
धर्षित (II) n. 1. Continuity; 2. copulation, cohabitation.
धारक m. 1. A vessel of any kind; 2. a debtor.
धारणक m. A debtor.
धारयित्री f. The earth.
धारा-अग्र n. the broad-edged head of an arrow.
धारा-अंकुर m. 1. a drop of rain; 2. hail; 3. advancing before the line of an army.
धारा-अंग m. a sword.
धारा-अट m. 1. the chātaka bird; 2. a horse; 3. a cloud; 4. a furious elephant.
धारा-अधिरूढ a. raised to the highest pitch.
धारा-अवनि f. wind.
धारा-अश्रु n. flood of tears, Am.
धारा-आसार m. a heavy downfall of rain.
धारा-उष्ण a. warm from a cow (as milk).
धारा-गृह n. 1. a bathroom with water-jets, a shower-bath; 2. a house furnished with artificial jets of water, R.xvi.49.
धारा-निपात, -पात m. 1. a fall of rain, a pelting shower, Megh.i.48; 2. a stream of water.
धारा-निपात, -पात m. 1. a fall of rain, a pelting shower, Megh.i.48; 2. a stream of water.
धारा-यंत्र n. a fountain, Am.
धारा-वर्ष m.n. a hard unceasing shower, R.iv.82.
धारा-संपात m. a hard unceasing shower, R.iv.82.
धारा-वाहिन् a. incessant, continuous.
धारा-विष m. a crooked sword.
धारिणी f. The earth.
